title: Item 12a · The Registration link button and box
subtitle: Approved in each section, plus one unclear point. Every section has a Registration link box with the link and its QR code, but the buttons inside differ, and the box opens from different places: an outline button in the page header (Color Belt, Star), the page's blue button (Camps — only an icon on phones, never recorded: unclear), or the ⋯ menu (Black Belt). Forms calls it “Share” (it also holds kiosk mode). (Preview screenshots · PC size, phone 390 wide · fake data)

columns.label: Today

row.caption: 1. Color Belt: Copy link · Print flyer — no way to download the QR code (Star the same, one card per school).
2. Camps: Copy link · Download QR code — no flyer, as you chose (v0.232: you design camp flyers yourself). Black Belt the same, “no flyer for now”.
3. Black Belt: “Registration links” hides in the page's ⋯ menu.
4. Camps on a phone: just a blue QR square — no words (unclear: never recorded).

columns.note: Forms' “Share” already has all three (Copy · Download · Print a sign) plus kiosk mode, so it keeps its own name.

columns.label: Proposed (option B) · one button, one box

row.caption: 5. The box everywhere: the link and QR code for each school, with Copy link · Download QR code · Print flyer (Camps and Black Belt keep no flyer, as decided).
6. Black Belt: the same outline “Registration link” button in the page header, instead of the ⋯ item.

items.caption: 7. Camps on a phone: the button keeps its words, on its own line under the title, as Color Belt's does.

columns.note: Copies what's already there: Star's two-school box, Black Belt's and Camps' Download QR code button, and Color Belt's header button. Pictures 5–7 are drawn over the real pages; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · Keep as today. + no work. − the QR code can be downloaded in some sections but not others; Black Belt's link hides in ⋯; Camps' phone button is a bare icon.
B · Recommended: one Registration link button and box. The same “Registration link” button with words on every screen, in the page header (Black Belt moves it out of ⋯; Camps keeps its blue because it's that page's main button). Inside: Copy link and Download QR code everywhere; Print flyer where it is today (Color Belt, Star; Forms' Print a sign) — Camps and Black Belt stay without a flyer, as decided. + the same place and the same buttons everywhere; the QR image for your own flyers in every section. − small changes in four sections.
C · All three buttons everywhere. As B, but Camps and Black Belt get Print flyer too. + no exceptions. − reverses your Camps choice (you make camp flyers yourself) and Black Belt's “no flyer for now”.
